enet_v21.label: EnergyNet v2.1 as released
enet_v21.family_label: Multilayer perceptron (ensemble of 5, correction to a physics estimate)

compute.notes: released model, not retrained here (trained by EnergyNet on an RTX 3080, 5 networks x ~5 min, 86,400 simulated trips)

enet_v21.feature_engineering: EnergyNet's own 151 inputs (the table track's definition)

trace_gru.label: Bidirectional GRU on the trip trace

compute.notes: r0 0.58, r1 0.54, r2 0.51 (rejected); + 0.02 for a speed benchmark and a 2-min first launch killed for memory; one thread, shared 2-core machine

trace_gru.feature_engineering: trace-track inputs only: the harness's shared 5-s block means (bake.block_means rule: 8 channel means + mean v^2, mean v^3, summed positive kinetic-energy increment per unit mass) + the block's valid-second fraction -> 12 scaled channels; spec (49) and rl (5, logs of mass / CdA / Crr) standardised with train-bank statistics; log distance and log duration from the trace; chunks of <= 1,440 blocks mean-pooled for longer traces; anchor r0 = sim-train median MJ/km per (architecture, class) (bake.dumb_rates) x distance; from r1: E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs by bake.e_phys_from_trace (EnergyNet's generic road-load estimate; declared), target log(y / E_phys), log(E_phys / A0) as an input

r2_d1_gru.label: Bidirectional GRU, 5-member ensemble on 3 banks (round 2, D1)

compute.notes: 5 members x 12 epochs on 86,400 trips (3 banks), RTX 3080 shared by up to 8 jobs: 14-20 min wall per member (1.39 GPU-h in all), process CPU 0.23-0.31 h per member (1.29 h). The v1.0 rungs r0-r2 (1.65 single-thread CPU-h) are the incumbent's.

r2_d1_gru.feature_engineering: as v1.0 trace_gru r1 (arms_trace/common/tracelib.py, unchanged): 5-s block means of the 1 Hz trace (12 channels), spec (49) and road load (5) standardised with train101 statistics, log distance / duration, physics anchor E_phys recomputed from the trace inputs (bake.e_phys_from_trace, declared), target log(y / E_phys), log(E_phys / A0) as an input. Ensemble: mean log-quantile per level over the 5 members, pred = exp(mean log q50) (round2/arms/common/enslib.py)

references.ephys: EnergyNet physics estimate E_phys alone (generic road-load model, no network)
references.label: VED: window-sticker label x distance (RoadData, dev-fitted mix)
references.moves_like: VED: MOVES-like VSP operating-mode model (RoadData, dev-fitted)
references.class_median: VED: dev median energy per km per (type, class) (RoadData)
references.regression: EPA: dev-fitted log-linear regression on the test car spec
references.dev_median: EPA / Mersin / ICCT / ZTBus: dev median (EPA, Mersin), dev truck same cycle (ICCT), dev kWh/km x distance (ZTBus)

notes: MdAPE = median |pred / y - 1| over units; bias = median (pred / y - 1); cov50 / cov90 = share of units inside q25-q75 / q05-q95; crps_log = 5-quantile CRPS on log energy (point rows: |log error|)

paired bootstrap over clusters (VED vehicles, ZTBus missions, EPA test vehicles, Mersin trips), 2,000 resamples, against EnergyNet v2.1, E_phys and the set's classical baseline(s); win / loss only when the 95 % interval of the difference excludes 0
VED predictions are scaled by the valid-energy share of the trip (EnergyNet / RoadData label definition)
reference rows label / moves_like / class_median / regression / dev_median are fitted on dev only
